pages.text: $(o)A forge-born giant of netherite and lava that guards the Soul Blacksmith's forge in the Nether.$()$(br2)$(l)Counter:$() Its smash shakes the floor and leaves fire behind. Roll the smash, and never stand in its lava.$(br2)Bring fire resistance. Everything here burns.
$(l)Defeated.$()$(br2)Its $(item)Molten Heart$() counts for the quest book, and the kill earns an Ascension point.
